messages:
kevin_support: Heads up — customer #842 started getting repeated 400s from fncall in JSON mode after upgrading SDK yesterday. Error in logs: "Function arguments failed schema validation: missing key 'order_lines'". They sent a repro payload.
prod-bot: error=malformed_function_call request_id=rc_9f3a status=400
yasmin_engineer: Can you paste the exact request body the SDK produced? suspect double-encoding of the arguments field from the SDK or our proxy.
kevin_support: Pasting minimal repro (customer redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-extended-1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"create order"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"create_order","parameters":{"type":"object","required":["order_id","order_lines"]}}],
  "function_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\"order_id\":\"123\",\"order_lines\":\"[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"X1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":2}]\"}"}
```
kevin_support: Customer also attached their SDK call: `client.callFunction('create_order', JSON.stringify(args))` — they passed a string on purpose after an internal transform.
yasmin_engineer: That payload is the issue — arguments is a string and order_lines ended up as a quoted string instead of an array. JSON mode expects `arguments` to be a real JSON object (with arrays as arrays). Our validator should return a clearer error than schema missing.
paul_sre: Observed increased retries for that customer around the same time, CPU and queue latency spiked due to repeated validation + retries. Trace: https://tracing.internal/trace/rc_9f3a (internal). Also saw some 401s earlier for the same customer when token refresh failed which amplified retries.
kevin_support: Customer says reverting SDK back to 1.9.0 fixed it. They upgraded to 1.9.2 yesterday. Asking for credit for retry charges. Ticket #SUP-842 created.
yasmin_engineer: Short-term: tell them to send `arguments` as an object and not pass JSON.stringify. Example correct body: 
```json
"function_call": {"name":"create_order","arguments": {"order_id":"123","order_lines":[{"sku":"X1","qty":2}]}}
```
I will add a server-side validation that rejects string-encoded `arguments` with a 422 and a human-friendly message. Longer-term: add SDK lint/guard to prevent accidental stringification.
paul_sre: I'll triage the billing credit with finance and make a config to drop retries for that request pattern while we patch. For the auth 401s, ops is rotating token TTL to 30m to reduce expiry failures.
kevin_support: Customer confirmed they can patch locally but asks us to prioritize the server validation — they want to avoid others hitting the same.
yasmin_engineer: Adding PR to runtime now (validation + clearer error text). Will target a hotfix build today. :thumbsup:
